title: 'I've never seen anything like this' -- A U.S. doctor treats Ebola's youngest victims
summary: Dr. Rupa Narra is a U.S. pediatrician who arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to help care for stricken children. Nothing could have prepared her for what she'd face.
contentText:
